query: Our Python app has too much logging. Diagnose a failed SDK request and prepare diagnostic artifacts.
expected_behavior: Enables DEBUG on the nebius logger with a dedicated handler rather than changing the root logger.
Preserves the failed request object and records available request and trace IDs.
Provides the SDK debug dump and version without exposing intact credentials.
Finishes by showing artifact file paths or available download links and any available request Trace IDs; does not search for ticket tools or create/upload a ticket.
